definitions.explanation: A desire for something to happen or be true.

examples.japanese: ⟦{将来|しょうらい}→将来：01438_shourai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{希望|きぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: To have hope for the future.

examples.japanese: {希望|きぼう}⟦どおり→どおり：09884_doori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。

⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{希望|きぼう}している⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{機会|きかい}→機会：01302_kikai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I hope to work overseas, but I haven't had the chance yet.

notes:
{希望|きぼう} means hope or wish—both the emotion and a desired outcome.

VERBAL USE:
{希望|きぼう}する: to hope for, to wish for, to request

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {希望|きぼう}を{持|も}つ: to have hope
- {希望|きぼう}を{失|うしな}う: to lose hope
- ご{希望|きぼう}: your preference (polite)
- {希望|きぼう}どおり: as hoped
- {希望|きぼう}に{沿|そ}う: to meet one's wishes

COMPOUNDS:
- {希望者|きぼうしゃ}: applicant, person who wishes to
- {希望{日|び}: preferred date
- {希望{額|がく}: desired amount

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {願|ねが}い: wish (more personal)
- {望|のぞ}み: hope, desire
- {期待|きたい}: expectation
- {夢|ゆめ}: dream
